## VDown Mobile & CLI Media Downloader

A versatile media downloader available as both a Python CLI and a modern native Android companion app.

### 🌟 Key Highlights
- 📱 **Native Android Companion App**: Full Material Design 3 app featuring dark/AMOLED theme, smooth bottom navigation, in-app media player, and gallery integration.
- ⚡ **Facebook Videos & Reels Engine**: Direct extraction of HD/SD CDN streams from Facebook reels, videos, and mobile `/share/r/` & `/share/v/` links without requiring login.
- 🔗 **Android System Share Sheet**: Share any video or Reel directly from Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or web browsers to VDown for instant one-tap downloading.
- 🎵 **Studio-Quality Audio Extraction**: 320 kbps MP3, Lossless FLAC, M4A, and WAV extraction.
- 🎬 **TikTok Watermark-Free Engine**: Clean MP4 video downloads and HD photo slideshows.

### 📥 Downloads
- **Android APK**: Download [**vdown.apk**](https://github.com/dularacharith/vdown/releases/latest/download/vdown.apk) to install directly on your Android device.

---
### 💻 Desktop Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/dularacharith/vdown.git
cd vdown
./install.sh   # Linux / macOS
install.bat    # Windows
```
